name: NanDA Sore!?
source: Shujin Kou (a pun on the Japanese word for "protagonist") is exploring a school at night when he suddenly hears a voice from a cell phone call out "Help me, please!" It turns out to be a special cell phone that allows the owner to become a Warrior of Magic!
